title: Milei’s Social Media Machine Is Starting to Misfire in Argentina
title_cn: Milei 的社交媒体机器在阿根廷开始失灵
summary: Argentine President Javier Milei wielded social media as a powerful weapon when he stormed to power in 2023. Now the online machinery is laying bare the challenges before his reelection bid next year.
